correctItems.text: 16 STILL LIFE IN COLOUR From cave paintings to temple sculptures, objects were an integral part of artworks, but were never the main subject.
In Indian art, objects were depicted to convey symbolic meanings and were an integral part of the composition.
For example, the Dharma Chakra or wheel of law, weapons and musical instruments were held by deities, courtiers, and so on.
Artists got interested in arranging and studying a variety of natural, and human-made objects which remained still.
